justification: Both surfaces carry figural rock imagery and each includes at least one profile quadruped, but A is dominated by many repeated crescent boats with crew-stroke rows, stick humans and rows of dots, while B shows a single large-bodied animal in profile filling the panel with a smaller creature below. The manner differs too: A is flat, linear and highly schematic silhouette work in dense multi-figure composition; B is a modelled, relatively naturalistic single-animal relief, so no shared iconographic scheme is evident.
